title: Descent of the strict reduction tensor representative square
statement: For the normalized completion reindexing data and coherent tensor comparison, the strict pure-tensor comparison formula descends through the product K-flat localization to the whole-system reduction/tensor square, using the canonical system tensor comparison and canonical normalized ordinary tensor map.

source.place: Steps 2 and 4: strict pure-tensor calculation followed by K-flat localization descent.

proof.text: Use the quotient-generator and transition laws of the coherent completion reindexing data to identify the two strict maps on every homogeneous pure tensor and every tower transition.
Apply the tensor comparison descent and full faithfulness of the product K-flat localization to obtain the equality of the derived system arrows.
